name: nginx-multisite
description: Composite Chef cookbook for Nginx hosting three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static content, host hardening, firewall rules, Fail2ban, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and self-signed development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log-directory management, and cleanup of selected replication directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python, Git, PostgreSQL, and development dependencies; deploys a FastAPI application with a virtual environment, database and user, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
